channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jerome Robinson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jerome Robinson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Jerome Robinson
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Jerome Robinson:

“Great kid. Worked hard. He had a little bit of incosistency, things he had to get better with. I have nothing but praise for him. He’s a hard worker…He’s a pro.”

Scott Brooks on Jerome Robinson, Apr 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Michael Porter, Jerome Robinson, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Doc Rivers on how difficult it was assessing and passing on Michael Porter Jr. at 12 + 13 for Shai Gilgeous-Alexander + Jerome Robinson:

“Just the medical report, the red flag was so hot... it was a brutal pass because everyone knew his talent but it was more the injury concern.”

Doc Rivers on Michael Porter, Jerome Robinson, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Sep 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Jerome Robinson
item.description:
Farbod Esnaashari:Doc Rivers on Jerome Robinson hitting a game winner:

“I still believe in him. I just do. There's something in there.”

Doc Rivers on Jerome Robinson, Feb 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @Farbod_E.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Jerome Robinson
item.description:
“But when we do our scout rankings, we don’t allow out other scouts to look at the other scouts’ rankings because we don’t want to get into the group thing and you want to avoid the echo chamber. When you just kept on seeing [Jerome], you’re like, ‘OK, I think we’re onto something.’”

Lawrence Frank on Jerome Robinson, Jun 26, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Jerome Robinson, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Doc Rivers on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Jerome Robinson:

“We believe that No. 12 and 13 now is a great number to be drafted at. But five years from now, when everyone does the redraft, they’re going to say, ‘Wow, these guys should have been No. 2 and 3 [or] No. 1 and 2.’”

Doc Rivers on Jerome Robinson, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jun 25, 2018. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.
